post.description:
Create a unique link that automatically logs in a participant to the experience, skipping the login page.

**Notes:**
- The URL effectively automates the process of logging in the experience. This means that the login might fail if for example:
    - The experience is not yet open.
    - preRegisterStudent=false or was not set and the experience is fully booked at time of login.
    - preRegisterStudent=true and the experience has a maximum student limitation and is already fully booked.
    - The experience does not allow multiple environment activation and URL is used after an environment was already activated and expired.
- Unfilled or null custom fields, those listed in the registrationInfo object, might cause the login URL to show the class login page in order to the user to fill those fields if they’re required in the class’s project training settings. This behavior can be overriden by checking the Disable forced registration for experience Sponsored Links in the class’s project training settings. With this checked even if the Class Sponsored Link wasn’t generated with a required custom field, the student will be logged in.
- Concurrent requests that use the same experience ID with preRegisterStudent=true might data-race and result in overbooking, thus exceeding the maximum student limit for the class. To ensure that the maximum student limit is enforced for the experience, API requests must be received using a mutually exclusive method.
- The token will be valid for 5 minuets

Training_Experience_Response.title: Training Experience Response
Training_Experience_Response.description: This model represents the response that will be provided when retrieving data about a specific training experience, when completing the creation of a training experience, or editing a training experience.

id.description: The unique CloudShare ID given to the Training Experience.

name.description: The name given to the Training Experience by the creating user.

status.description: The current status of the experience.

accessLink.description: The link the user will use to access their hands on Training experience.

passphrase.description: The passphrase students need to enter the Training experience if the access type selected is passphrase.

createdBy.description: The email of the user who created the Training Experience.

createdDate.description: The date-time of when the Training Experience was created.

lastUpdatedBy.description: The last user email which made at least one edit to the Training Experience.

lastUpdatedDate.description: The date-time of when the Training Experience was last edited.

blueprintIds.description: The Blueprint ID(s) that have been seleceted for this Training Experience.

start.description: The date which the Training experience will begin. The start date must have a start time. Date format is ISO 8601 without a timezone: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm

end.description: The date which the Training experience will end. Date format is ISO 8601 without a timezone: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm

timeZone.description: The timezone in which the experience will occur. The timezone affects the start and end date-times.

earlyAccessTime.description: If accessTime allows access before the time of the Training experience, choose how long in Minutes users can enter their lab.

useCustomInvitationEmail.description: Whether or not the invitation emails are customized

preConfigureParticipantEnvironments.description:
When this field is enabled (TRUE), users can create preconfigured student environments.
The option is available only to accounts with this feature as part of their active subscription plan.

allowAudioVideo.description: Enables the broadcast feature in the instructor console and viewer

Training_Experience.title: Training Experience
Training_Experience.description: This model includes all parameters related to a Training Experience. This model will be used when creating a new Training Experience.

name.description: A unique name for the Training experience. The name must be longer than 2 characters.

type.description: The type of Training experience which will be delivered to students. Only 1 value can be supported per experience.

projectId.description: The project ID to which the experience is related.

teamId.description: The team ID to which the experience should be assinged.

blueprintIds.description: Blueprint ID(s) which should be used within the Training Experience. One or more Blueprints may be selected. The order of the Blueprints listed will be the order of their appearance in the experience. When you add multiple Blueprints to your experience, it is considered a multistep experience.

allowParticipantsSwitchSteps.description: Determines whether participants are allowed to navigate between steps (i.e., Blueprints) in a multistep experience. When set to true, participants have the option to move between steps on their own. When set to false, the instructor will need to manually move participants between steps.
